cross_period_normalization: Model announcement, preview availability, product rollout, API availability, GA, and later deprecation are separate objective chronology identities when materially distinct.
SearchGPT prototype and ChatGPT search are related but distinct lifecycle events; the December 16 availability expansion is a chronology detail rather than a new model identity.
OpenAI o1-preview/o1-mini, full o1 product availability, and the o1-2024-12-17 API snapshot remain distinct events.

Open weights, source-code availability, license permissiveness, hosted API availability, training-data transparency, and edge deployability are separate properties; the reader-facing text must not collapse them into a single 'open source' label.
Agent research prototypes, computer-use public beta, protocol publication, and generally available products remain distinct deployment states.
Gemini 2.0 Flash, Project Mariner, Jules, and Deep Research may share an announcement but must not be presented as the same artifact or the same availability state.

DeepSeek-V3's December 26 availability is a 2024-H2 event; DeepSeek-R1's January 2025 public release must not be back-projected into H2 even when later technical material discusses R1-related post-training.
